name: Chronicles of Immortality in the Cloud Abyss
detailed_description:
Cloud Chronicle is a third-person 3D action Roguelike set in a mystical world of floating islands. You play as a cultivator who flies freely through procedurally generated maps, exploring ancient ruins, battling enemies in aerial combat, and building your own path to immortality.

Key Features

  • Aerial Combat
    Engage in fast-paced 3D battles with assist aiming and auto-tracking. Easily perform dashes, mid-air dodges, and large-scale attacks.

  • Skill and Build Variety
    Discover over 100 skills, spells, artifacts, and elixirs. Each run offers randomized choices to craft unique builds and combat styles.

  • Procedural Stages & Replayability
    Each playthrough includes random events, elite enemies, boss fights, and different route options. No two runs are the same.

  • Designed for All Players
    With forgiving controls and guided targeting, even players unfamiliar with action or shooter games can enjoy fluid aerial battles.

  • Current Version Includes

    • 5+ zone types with randomized layouts

    • 10+ enemy types and elite variants

    • 5 bosses

    • Dozens of relics and active abilities

    • Full solo gameplay loop

  • Planned Features
    Future updates will add local co-op multiplayer, more maps, skills, and bosses to expand your journey.
